name: 🎃Fright Fighters
desc:
[🚨Disclaimer: Fright Fighters is a casual game. It is intentionally designed with stupid/unfair plays in mind, it is more of a party game and not entirely dependant on strategy! Keep this in mind!!]

Fright Fighters is an 8 player arena fighter with indie/internet horror icons of both past and present, a FFA where they will battle with unique movesets and the one who kills the most comes out on top! Join The Fright, it's expecting you...

📍Expect bugs, game is currently in Beta
🔧Private Server owners will get special controls over their server

Any concerns related to your own material/characters being used in this game should go to awes0meshapes directly, I'll make sure to take care of it! Otherwise all credits go to their respective creators which will be in-game listed directly with the character/skin info.

Inspired by Strife by Fenrier, Smash Mobs, & Pillar Chase 2 by The_BladeNinja.
